name: my-pi-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the my-pi launcher and @spences10/pi-* packages
author: Scott Spence <spences10apps@gmail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm run preview:check && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self
scripts.check: pnpm run preview:check && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && vp check --deny-warnings && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run check:self
scripts.test: pnpm run test:lint && pnpm run test:preview && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter "./packages/*" --if-present run test:self
scripts.preview:generate: pnpm --filter my-pi run build && node scripts/package-preview/generate.ts
scripts.preview:check: pnpm --filter my-pi run build && node scripts/package-preview/generate.ts --check
scripts.test:preview: pnpm --filter my-pi run build && node --test scripts/package-preview/*.test.ts
scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && pnpm run build && changeset publish
scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build:self && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter "./packages/*" --if-present run coverage:self
